answer: Scarce-Resource Attestation Ledger. Agents earn non-transferable credits only by completing verifiable compute tasks whose outputs are checked by an independent verifier. Registration costs a fixed credit balance drawn from this ledger, not currency. Credits vest slowly over an ember-like decay curve, so bulk-made identities can't accumulate enough to register without sustained useful work. Sybils must pay real compute across many accounts, and each fake node dilutes the shared umber pool, raising marginal cost. A ridge threshold caps total identities per operator.
